name: Audi e-gas plant, Werlte, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: 6 MW power-to-methane plant using renewable electricity, water and CO2 from a nearby biogas plant; opened June 2013, the world's largest power-to-gas facility at the time

sources.note: Audi e-gas reporting (opened 2013, 6 MW input, world's largest PtG facility at commissioning); read 2026-10-28
